title: The Midnight Hollow
author: Sebastian Ishikawa
blurb: Rosalind Quintana, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
